msg = ''

records = env['home.warranty'].search([['state','=','Seller'],['seller_invoice_status','=','draft']])

for rec in records:
  r = rec.confirm_seller()
  if r == True:
    msg += rec.name + '\n'
  else:
    msg += rec.name + str(r) + '\n'

if msg != '':
    log(msg,level='info')

name: SUB: Compute Coverage
code:
# Available variables:
#  - env: Odoo Environment on which the action is triggered
#  - model: Odoo Model of the record on which the action is triggered; is a void recordset
#  - record: record on which the action is triggered; may be void
#  - records: recordset of all records on which the action is triggered in multi-mode; may be void
#  - time, datetime, dateutil, timezone: useful Python libraries
#  - log: log(message, level='info'): logging function to record debug information in ir.logging table
#  - Warning: Warning Exception to use with raise
# To return an action, assign: action = {...}

message = ''

products = env['product.product'].search([('can_be_expensed', '=', True)])

for p in products:
  p._compute_get_terms()

subs = env['sale.subscription'].search([('state', 'in', ['open', 'pending']), ('home_warranty', '!=', False)])

records = subs.mapped('recurring_invoice_line_ids')

c = 0

for r in records:
  if not r.covered_items and r.product_id.warranty_terms_id:
    msg = r['analytic_account_id'].name.ljust(30) + ' ' + r['analytic_account_id'].partner_id.name.rjust(40)
    msg += ' ' + str(r['analytic_account_id']['date_start']).rjust(30) + '\n'
    msg += r['name'] + '\n'
    for t in r.product_id.warranty_terms_id:
      msg += '\t' + str(t.name) + '\n'
    msg += r.calc_coverage()
    message += msg + '-------------------------------\n'
    c += 1

message += '-------------------------------\nCount: '+ str(c).rjust(10)

if c > 0:
  log(message, level='info')
